source.name: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 states and provinces

notes: Each prefecture is reduced to its largest outer ring (tsumiki-style single piece) and simplified to at most 72 vertices. Coordinates are centred on the polygon centroid and pre-scaled to playable size; y points north (up). `map` holds normalised centroid offsets and `mapPoly` the shared-space polygon for the collection map (equirectangular projection, Okinawa in its own inset box).
